scope: CAN0 REGISTER-LEVEL configuration and transmit-completion ONLY. The block is clocked, leaves reset, accepts bit timing and filters, and reports completed transmissions with no error counters set. NO CAN BITS HAVE BEEN OBSERVED ON A WIRE: the routed TX pad idles recessive-high and shows no edges while frames complete, consistent with self-test mode looping back internally. Note two corrections banked with this row: reading TXFRAME back at +0x40 returns the RX window (that window is a union: write=TX buffer, read=RX, reset-mode=ACR/AMR) so an earlier "TX buffer refuses writes" reading was wrong; and the earlier "TBS never asserts" belief was a bounded wait SHORTER than the ~25 ms frame time at BRP=63, not dead hardware.

SPI0 single-wire RX PHASE_DATA lane placement on the exact routed L48 full-duplex image: for widths 1..4, sampled-high receive bytes occupy the LOW-order bytes while upper bits below width four retain unrelated shift-register state. This silicon-qualifies masking the public ag32_spi_write_read result to the requested width. The exact vendor image was first accepted with FCB_STAT 0x000f0002 by the hash-bound canonical loader, then the checked-in witness was loaded into SRAM without resetting the fabric. The Pico used input pulls only and never drove against the bidirectional pad. Because PIN_17 remained high under both weak pulls, arbitrary-zero data, byte order within multi-byte RX, true slave-driven duplex interoperability, SPI1, DUAL/QUAD, DMA, and absolute SCK timing remain unqualified. SRAM only; no flash writes; board reset and Pico ALLIN after the run.

SPI0 active slave-driven single-wire receive and TX-then-RX duplex phase sequence on the exact routed L48 image. A checked-in RP2350 PIO oracle on GP7/PIN_17 drove prefixes of 12 34 56 78 after the one-byte A5 command. Four fresh-oracle runs prove that raw PHASE_DATA stores received bytes in reverse order in its low lanes and retains unrelated upper state below width four; the repaired ag32_spi_write_read reverses exactly the requested bytes and returned the natural right-justified wire values at widths 1..4. Each image was first accepted with FCB_STAT 0x000f0002. NOT qualified: SPI1, DUAL/QUAD, DMA/POLL, transfers beyond four polling bytes, non-power-of-two dividers, or absolute SCK/reference timing. AG32 SRAM only, no AG32 flash writes. The Pico oracle firmware was temporary; the original protocol analyzer image was restored and verified by PING plus ALLIN. The AG32 was reset after every run.

I2C0 active open-drain master interoperability on the exact routed L48 SDA PIN_11 / SCL PIN_15 image. A checked-in RP2350 software slave at 7-bit address 0x55 supplied the pull-ups, ACKed both address directions, ACKed the master write byte 0xA6, and drove read byte 0x5A; the AG32 master terminated the read with NACK+STOP. Silicon sets SR.RXNACK for that intentional terminal master NACK (final SR 0x81). Before repair the generic wait path returned -3 despite RXR=0x5A; the repaired last-byte path treats only that expected condition as success and returned 0x5A. NOT qualified: multi-byte reads/writes, repeated START, clock stretching, 10-bit addresses, arbitration/multimaster, I2C1, or absolute SCL timing. AG32 SRAM only, no AG32 flash writes. The Pico oracle firmware was temporary; the original protocol analyzer image was restored and verified by PING plus ALLIN. The AG32 was reset after the run.

I2C0 exact active open-drain register-style transaction on routed L48 SDA PIN_11 / SCL PIN_15, reproduced in three fresh full-load runs. The AG32 wrote bytes 0x2A and 0xA6 without STOP, issued a repeated START in read direction to the same 7-bit address 0x55, then read 0x5A 0xC3 0x7E while driving ACK after the first two bytes and NACK+STOP after the third. Every address, write, and read HAL status was zero; final SR=0x81 is the intentional terminal master NACK. This qualifies that exact multi-byte write, repeated-START direction change, three-byte read, and ACK/ACK/NACK sequence. NOT qualified: arbitrary lengths, STOP-delimited multi-byte writes, clock stretching, 10-bit addresses, arbitration/multimaster, I2C1, interrupts/DMA, or absolute SCL timing. AG32 SRAM only and no AG32 flash writes. The temporary Pico oracle was replaced by the original analyzer and PING plus ALLIN passed; AG32 was reset after the run.
